  unit:
    name: DNS Unit & Cross-Compile
    runs-on: ubuntu-24.04
    steps:
      - name: Checkout
        uses: actions/checkout@v4

      - name: Setup Go
        uses: actions/setup-go@v5
        with:
          go-version: "1.27.3"

      - name: Lint & Vet
        run: make -f mk/dns.mk dns-lint

      - name: Cross-Compile (linux/amd64 and linux/arm64)
        run: make -f mk/dns.mk dns-build

      - name: Unit Tests
        run: make -f mk/dns.mk dns-test

      - name: Pinned resolver response shape (AT20)
        run: make -f mk/dns.mk dns-response-shape

      - name: Pinned resolver positive cache and TTL (AT20)
        run: make -f mk/dns.mk dns-positive-cache
